num_nodes: <int> Total number of terminals in the service network.
num_arcs: <int> Total number of directed service links in the network.
num_commodities: <int> Total number of commodities to be transported.
num_fleet_types: <int> Total number of distinct vehicle types available.
nodes: <list[int], length num_nodes> Set of terminal identifiers in the network.

arcs.from: <int> Origin terminal of this directed service link.
arcs.to: <int> Destination terminal of this directed service link.
arcs.flow_cost: <int> Per-unit cost for shipping one unit of any commodity along this arc.

commodities.destination: <int> Terminal where this commodity must be delivered.
commodities.demand: <int> Quantity of this commodity that must be shipped from origin to destination.

fleet_types.id: <int> Unique identifier for this vehicle type.
fleet_types.capacity: <int> Maximum total flow that one vehicle of this type can carry on an arc.
fleet_types.fixed_cost: <int> Cost incurred for deploying one vehicle of this type on any arc.
